scope: disk-file inventory and selected static facts only; no Unity, playtest or tests run
limitations: Direct prefab expansion only, not a general Unity deserializer.
Nested prefab components, array reference overrides and runtime collider baking are not validated by the extraction.
Selected sampled prefab outer parent transforms verified identity.
Tile positions are serialized cells with explicit SurfaceSemantic2D, not collision semantics inferred from names.
Box AABBs are static geometry, not proof of traversal or runtime active state.
Scores assess documented design hypotheses, not player experience.
